LightningComponentBundle.description: B2B / B2C - Visual Contact card (avatar, details, up to 3 gauges) with animated waves + optional Einstein prompt summary. Original author: Charly Ansel.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls every visible label.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Leave empty to use the dictionary default ('Contact').

property.name: hideHeaderOnContact
property.label: Hide card header on Contact page
property.description: Off by default. Turn ON to remove the card title + icon when the component is placed on a Contact record page (the page already tells the user it is a contact).

property.name: imageFieldApiName
property.label: Image URL field API name (optional)
property.description: Schema-safe: skipped if absent. When the contact has a value in this URL field, it wins over any uploaded file. Leave empty to rely solely on the click-to-upload File storage.

property.name: disableImageReplace
property.label: Disable click-to-replace image
property.description: Off by default - clicking the avatar opens a file picker and uploads the new image as a File on the linked Contact (works on Contact, Case, Account etc. record pages). Turn ON to lock the avatar.

property.name: customerIdFieldApiName
property.label: Customer ID field API name
property.description: Schema-safe: the line is skipped if the field is absent or empty.

property.name: gauge1Label
property.label: Gauge 1 - label
property.description: Leave empty to hide the first gauge.

property.name: gauge1FieldApiName
property.label: Gauge 1 - field API name (optional)
property.description: Numeric Contact field (0-100). When set and the record has a numeric value, it wins over the static value below. Schema-safe: skipped if absent.

property.name: gauge1Value
property.label: Gauge 1 - static value (optional)
property.description: Type a number directly (0-100) to display it without needing a field. Useful for demos. Used as a fallback when the field above is empty.

property.name: gauge1Direction
property.label: Gauge 1 - semantics
property.description: 'lower-better' (0=green, 100=red) for risk-style metrics. 'higher-better' (0=red, 100=green) for health / satisfaction.

property.name: hideWaves
property.label: Hide animated waves
property.description: Off by default - the card shows soft animated wave shapes tinted with the active Lightning theme accent. Turn ON to hide them.

property.name: showWaves
property.label: (deprecated) Show animated waves
property.description: No longer used. Use 'Hide animated waves' above.

property.name: isDarkBackground
property.label: Dark background
property.description: Switches text color to white. Use in tandem with a dark background color / image.

property.name: backgroundColor
property.label: Background color (CSS)
property.description: Optional. Example: '#fff', 'rgb(30,30,60)'.

property.name: backgroundImageUrl
property.label: Background image URL
property.description: Optional. Add the external domain to Trusted Sites if needed.

property.name: waveColorOne
property.label: Wave 1 color (override)
property.description: Optional CSS color. Leave empty to use a tinted version of the Lightning theme accent.

property.name: waveColorTwo
property.label: Wave 2 color (override)
property.description: Optional CSS color. Leave empty to use a lighter tint of the theme accent.

property.name: disablePromptSummary
property.label: Disable prompt summary (Einstein)
property.description: Off by default - the 'Résumer / Summarize' button is displayed and uses the prompt template below. Turn ON to hide the button entirely.

property.name: enablePromptSummary
property.label: (deprecated)
property.description: Use 'Disable prompt summary' above. This property is kept for backwards compatibility only.

property.name: promptButtonLabel
property.label: Prompt button label (override)
property.description: Leave empty for the dictionary default ('Résumer' / 'Summarize').

property.name: promptTemplateApiName
property.label: Prompt template API name
property.description: Developer name of the Einstein Prompt Template to run. Defaults to the SDO-standard contact summary template ('einstein_gpt__summarizeContact').

property.name: promptInputApiName
property.label: Prompt template input API name
property.description: Typically 'Input:Contact'.

property.name: autoPromptOnLoad
property.label: Run prompt automatically on load
property.description: When on and the prompt is enabled, the summary fires as soon as the component loads - no button click required.
